•  Sampling is the technique by which LLMs choose the next token. The most
   commonly used are:

•  Sampling is the technique by which LLMs choose the next token. The most

Encoder-Decoder Architecture
•  The original Transformer introduced by Google featured a full
   encoder-decoder architecture, which was initially designed for
                                                      ENCODER
    tasks like machine translation.
•  Unmasked Self-Attention: An encoder shares the same core
   components as a decoder (Multi-Head Attention, FFN, & Layer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        DECODER
   Norm), but it drops the masking function that hides the future
    tokens.
    ─Without this mask enforcing a left-to-right sequence, the
        attention mechanism becomes bidirectional, allowing both
        past & future tokens to influence the attention computation
•  The Foundation for Vision: This unmasked, global processing is
   why the encoder architecture is used for Vision Transformers
     (ViTs) that allow the model to process an entire image at once &
    understand the relationships between all patches simultaneously,
    rather than reading them left-to-right.
